# implement-spec ledger — P14.2 exports

- **Spec:** docs/tickets/P14.2__exports.md (cites canonical §38, §42.4)
- **Base branch:** devin/p14-1-public-api
- **Base commit:** 4493b14 (after committing the stray analytics/suppression hardening as its own commit)
- **Feature branch:** devin/p14-2-exports
- **Config:** full (all rigor phases on)

## Key architectural facts discovered (Phase 0.3)
- Licence primitives ALREADY EXIST in `policy/src/policy/licensing.py`:
  compute_export_license (SIG-LIC-004a/010, raises LicenseIncompatibilityError),
  assert_export_permitted (SIG-LIC-004 fail-closed), effective_license
  (SIG-LIC-009a silently-travelling), downstream_obligations (SIG-LIC-011),
  compartments(), assert_training_allowed. Registry data: policy/data/licenses.toml.
- Rights model: policy.rights.RightsRecord; connectors.registry.rights_records().
- Crosswalk ALREADY EXISTS: resolution.crosswalk.build_sig_external_crosswalk /
  build_ori_geoid_crosswalk / export_crosswalk (licence-gated).
- ODbL physical-asset rows: connectors.osm.physical_asset_rows -> rows stamped
  license=ODbL-1.0, compartment=osm_physical.
- API /export is INDEX ONLY (api/routes.py export_index); P14.2 owns bulk builders.
- DEP DIRECTION: api & connectors depend on sig-exports => exports MUST NOT import
  api (cycle). "Same code path the API uses" = shared policy.licensing /
  resolution.crosswalk / reconcile.resolve, which the API also calls.
- Deps available in venv: duckdb (parquet), rdflib, sqlite3, csv/json/hashlib/tomllib.
  pyarrow/shapely/pmtiles NOT installed.
- Test layout: tests/exports/*.py; import `from exports.x import ...`.
- ADRs: docs/adr/ADR-0NN-*.md; test requires a "## Revisit trigger" section.
- Traceability: docs/traceability.md (grouped by ticket). Risk register: docs/risk_register.md.
- Build gate: `make check` = lint + format-check + typecheck + test + verify-gen.

## Plan / module design (exports/src/exports/)
- manifest.py  — BuildSpec(as_of pair, ruleset_version, resolver_version) + release_id;
  Artifact(name,path,media_type,compartment,license,sha256,bytes,row_count); Manifest (deterministic).
- compartments.py — ExportTable/ExportRow; partition_by_compartment (keyed on rights,
  SIG-LIC-004a); per-compartment computed licence + fail on incompatible mix; per-row
  rights provenance (downstream_obligations).
- formats.py — deterministic writer registry: csv, jsonl, geojson, jsonld(rdf), parquet(duckdb), sqlite.
- frictionless.py — datapackage.json (tabular) + RO-Crate ro-crate-metadata.json (evidence).
- zenodo.py — deposit over injectable transport Protocol; concept + version DOI; digest
  manifest deposited, evidence bytes excluded; FakeZenodo for tests.
- distribution.py — egress-friendly object-storage + CDN/mirror descriptor (SIG-EXPORT-008);
  torrent/IPFS (magnet/CID) for largest artifacts (SIG-EXPORT-009).
- downstream.py — six downstream application classes validation (SIG-EXPORT-010/011).
- bundle.py — orchestrator: build_bundle(build_spec, tables, rights, crosswalk...) ->
  writes artifacts + manifest; crosswalk as its own most-permissive artifact (SIG-EXPORT-007);
  byte-identical reproducibility (SIG-EXPORT-003).
- cli.py — add `build` subcommand.
- pyproject: add sig-policy, sig-resolution, duckdb (+ reconcile if resolution routing used).

## Requirements checklist (from spec)
SIG-EXPORT-001 versioned bulk artifacts (7 formats) + checksums + manifest
SIG-EXPORT-002 Frictionless (tabular) + RO-Crate (evidence) + Zenodo concept+version DOI + digest manifest
SIG-EXPORT-003 reproducible from (as_of pair + ruleset + resolver) via same code path as API
SIG-EXPORT-004 / SIG-LIC-010 computed licence; build FAILS on incompatible share-alike mix
SIG-EXPORT-005 ODbL separate file; CC-BY separate
SIG-EXPORT-006 / SIG-LIC-011 per-row rights provenance passed downstream
SIG-EXPORT-007 crosswalk published separately, most-permissive licence
SIG-EXPORT-008 egress-friendly object storage + CDN/mirror
SIG-EXPORT-009 torrent/IPFS SHOULD for largest
SIG-EXPORT-010/011 six downstream classes; conflicts -> separate artifacts
SIG-LIC-009a silently-travelling share-alike -> stricter (reuse effective_license)

## Acceptance criteria (test matrix) — Phase 1.4
- AC1 (deterministic): incompatible share-alike mix in one table FAILS build ->
  test_compartments: compute_table_license raises LicenseIncompatibilityError;
  bundle build raises. + test that a same-compartment table succeeds.
- AC2 (deterministic): ODbL assets are a distinct ODbL-1.0 file never merged into
  CC-BY export; every row carries rights provenance -> test_bundle: two artifacts,
  distinct compartments/licences; every serialized row has a `rights` block.
- AC3 (deterministic): crosswalk produced separately, prominently, most-permissive
  licence -> test_bundle crosswalk artifact present, own compartment, licence == most
  permissive of constituents.
- AC4 (agentic): Zenodo deposit carries concept DOI + version DOI + digest manifest ->
  test_zenodo with FakeZenodo transport; live CLI drive in Phase 5.
- Repro (SIG-EXPORT-003): two builds from same BuildSpec are byte-identical; release_id
  deterministic -> test_manifest + test_bundle.
- SIG-EXPORT-001: 7 formats each produce bytes + checksum + manifest entry -> test_formats.
- SIG-EXPORT-002: datapackage.json (Frictionless) + ro-crate-metadata.json -> test_frictionless.
- SIG-EXPORT-006/011: per-row obligations -> test_compartments.
- SIG-LIC-009a: silently-travelling upstream -> stricter compartment -> test_compartments.
- SIG-EXPORT-008/009: distribution descriptor egress-friendly + torrent/IPFS -> test_distribution.
- SIG-EXPORT-010/011: six downstream classes each have a serving artifact -> test_downstream.

### Deviations recorded (ADR-048)
- PMTiles ships as a valid v3 archive carrying the ODbL layer as metadata; rendered
  vector tiles (tippecanoe-class) deferred to the map surface (Phase 15). GeoJSON of the
  ODbL layer is real+complete, so the route/privacy class's data need is served.
- derivative_permitted is NOT added to the export gate (SIG-LIC-004 gates redistributable
  + UNDETERMINED only, per §42.1/§42.4); expanding that shared gate is P00.4's contract.
## Evidence log (Phase 5)
- Full `make check` GREEN: ruff (327 files), format-check, mypy (175 files), pytest
  **2126 passed in 47s**, verify-gen (pylock+ontology diff clean — no regen needed).
- LIVE CLI (`sig-exports build ... --zenodo-dry-run --store cloudflare-r2:sig-bulk`):
  - 26 artifacts written to disk; ODbL layer under osm_physical/ (ODbL-1.0), CC-BY under
    sig_graph/ (CC-BY-4.0), crosswalk under crosswalk/ (CC0-1.0, most permissive).
  - manifest.json checksum verified against physical_assets.parquet on disk.
  - parquet readable by duckdb (2 rows); pmtiles valid v3 (magic+version+gzip metadata).
  - per-row rights present in ODbL jsonl (license=ODbL-1.0, share_alike=True).
  - datapackage.json excludes evidence; ro-crate-metadata.json includes it.
  - distribution.json store egress_class=zero; CDN/mirror URLs built.
  - Zenodo dry-run: concept_doi != version_doi; 5 evidence files excluded from deposit,
    digests.json + manifest.json deposited.
  - NEGATIVE: incompatible ODbL+CC-BY table in one file -> CLI exits 1, no output dir
    (LicenseIncompatibilityError, SIG-EXPORT-004/SIG-LIC-010).
- Docs: ADR-048 written (has Revisit trigger); traceability.md + risk_register.md updated
  with the full P14.2 requirement->test map and RISK-P14-11..18.
